responsibility: Implements the Epiphany post-mode-switch RTL cleanup pass that resolves ambiguous software floating-point mode-setting insns after mode-switch analysis. It examines emitted set_fp_mode instructions, uses DF liveness and REG_UNUSED notes to choose a concrete rounding mode when the insn still carries FP_MODE_ROUND_UNKNOWN, updates the insn operands accordingly, and when conflicting successor requirements remain, inserts additional edge mode-setting sequences and commits them to the CFG. This file therefore owns the backend-specific finalization of Epiphany floating-point rounding-state transitions before later RTL stages proceed.
